errors.reply_unavailable: This server has no language model that may read mail, so Scout can't write replies here. Write this one yourself.
errors.reply_failed: Scout couldn't write the reply just now. Try again in a moment, or write it yourself.
errors.reply_ask_invalid: Say what the reply should say in 1 to {{max}} characters.
errors.invalid_limit: The limit must be between 1 and {{max}}.
errors.invalid_cursor: This page link is not valid. Start again from the first page.
errors.invalid_label_name: A label name must be 1 to {{max}} characters long.
errors.inbox_read_only: You can read this inbox but not change its conversations. Ask its manager for sender access.
errors.draft_needs_inbox: A new message needs the inbox to send it from.
errors.draft_needs_message: A reply or forward needs the message it answers.
errors.too_many_recipients: A message can have at most {{max}} recipients.
errors.invalid_subject: A subject is one line of at most {{max}} characters.
errors.draft_too_long: This message is too long to send.
errors.draft_changed: This draft was changed somewhere else. Reload it to see the latest version.
errors.draft_not_editable: This message is on its way and can no longer be changed.
errors.attachments_too_large: Attachments can add up to {{max}} MB at most.
errors.too_late: It is too late to undo: the message has already left.
errors.invalid_ids: Ask for between 1 and {{max}} conversation ids, separated by commas.
errors.no_open_need: Nothing here needs you any more.
errors.not_a_payment: This isn't a payment to make.
errors.nothing_to_reopen: There is nothing to bring back here.
errors.need_changed: This changed while you were looking at it. Have another look.
errors.invalid_rule: This rule can't be saved. It needs one to four conditions that say which mail it is about, and one to four actions of different kinds.
errors.rule_not_yours: Only the person who taught this rule, or a manager of the inbox, can change it.
errors.rule_not_proposed: This rule is not waiting for a yes any more.
errors.rule_needs_member: Rules are taught by a member of the inbox, not by an app.
errors.rule_not_active: This rule is waiting for a yes. Keep it first, then you can pause it.
errors.rule_not_restorable: This rule can't be brought back any more. Teach it again instead.
errors.rule_needs_confirmation: This rule needs a yes again before it acts. Confirm it first, then you can change it.
errors.invalid_senders_query: Search with 2 to 100 characters, and ask for 1 to {{max}} senders.
errors.images_already_trusted: A smart rule already covers this sender's images, even if it is paused or waiting for a yes. Find it in Scout's memory.
